review_description: Very credible installer and provided a competitive quote. Only interested in a quality system.
The reason we went with you as the face to face consult by the salesman who was fantastic very thorough

Quotation was provided quickly with phone consultation to understand our needs and expectations.Installers were polite and efficient, maintaining a tidy and safe work environment. They walked me through the process of understanding the system and how to use the app.All paperwork and connection details have been handled by them.

From start to finish, they did an onsite appraisal, gave me several options and out-priced any other quotes . Their electrician organised all the work for the 3 phase upgrade and did a beautiful job with the install. I couldn’t be more happy with the outcome.highly recommend them . I used their San Remo branch . My price for the install doesn’t include 3 phase connection

After a lot of research using the SolarQuotes website (huge thank-you for all the free information readily available here) I asked for a quote on a 10kW inverter (Sungrow SH10RS) and 30x panels (Jinko JKM440N-54HL4R-B).Island Energy didn't hesitate. I received a quote from them and it was the most affordable of the bunch. Once I'd accepted the quote I was engaged by Anthony who responded to all of my emails and assisted at each step of the way. The man deserves a beer for his professionalism and response times.Install day came and went. I was originally a little surprised to see the job had been subcontracted out, but by the end of the day it was clear they only subcontract to the best where necessary. It was a two male, 1 female team, starting at about 7.30am and leaving at 5pm. A long day in the heat, that's for sure. The installer was hell-bent on ensuring those up the street who can see the panels on the roof would only see the most tidy and neat job. The care-factor was next-level by all of them. I was provided a quick run-down at the end which tied up the positive experience.At the present time, I'm waiting for the installation inspection to occur. The system was installed on 12-Dec-24 and it's currently 5-Jan-25. I'm really hoping for a call this coming week. For those looking to install solar, I'd recommend locking in an install date no later than the end of September.
All processes were easy with Island Energy.The installer was great to deal with.Quality of the work was very good

Island Energy were amazing from start to finish. Nothing was too much trouble from the 1st phone call to completion. Information was very helpful being a 1st time Solar installation.If you are thinking of getting Solar call these guys, you won't be sorry.Very happy customerMarilyn Murphy

Was the only quotation that didn’t involve a site visit however the installer did ask the right questions to establish relevant and unusual features of the site. This resulted in the best technical solution offered by any of the installers.The price was also reasonable and lower than some others.
The whole experience was easy and simple. Great service from all staff. A good company to deal with

- Quoting, descriptions of possible units, options and manufactures etc was good.- Installation was excellent, on time, tidy etc- Installer did show me a few things about the Inverter, etc. via his Mobile Phone. But we could not get the Inverter to connect to my WiFi. He says I will need to get a WiFi booster. I asked if they can hard wire the Inverter to my Optus Router, and they did not want to to that. So after they left I went and bought a Wi Fi extender, which I hope I can place somewhere inside the house but closer to the outside inverter. The installer said that when the inspection is done and the Inverter is allowed to be turned ON, he will come back and help me connect the WiFi.- As far as Grid Connection is concerned, I was told that the inspection has to happen first, (I was told it can take up to 10 days) and I assume the inspector or the installer will inform the Distribution Company (so they can remotely re-program the meter), and then I assume either I have to inform my Retailer or they will.

Finally had our solar system installed by Island Energy in March 2024. They were very patient while we prepared the site for the install.Mark Cleverley did a site inspection and quote and answered 90% of our questions before we asked them.We explained our expectations of the solar system and Mark designed one we were happy with.We decided to go with a 13.2kw solar system with 13.5kw Tesla battery.He was very accommodating and happy to go that bit extra which convinced us to go with Island Energy.Andrew Male & 3 young chaps from ESI Solutions did the install, the only stipulation we had was the install had to be level, square and balanced to look at and that’s exactly what we got. The attached photos say it all.Mark was more than happy to have Andrew fit a new sub board we supplied as we needed to upgrade the existing damaged board.We also had a heat pump HWS installed.I work from home and use high power consumption equipment. We’ve gone from a 45 to 60kw a day winter usage to 2.5 to 5kw maximum per day and couldn’t be happier.We’re very happy we went with Island Energy as they were very helpful and conducted themselves very professionally and highly recommend them for your solar requirements.Our only regret is that we didn’t decide to install solar sooner.
The team at Island Energy have been very responsive and knowledgeable from quoting, and recommendations to meet our needs to the sale to the install.

Island energy were extremely easy to deal with. Our installation was completed in a very quick timeframe and the installers were a pleasure to work with. We are very happy with the way everything went and the quality of the installation. Thanks to Anthony, Andrew and his team. Gary and Sandi
Best quote price and process, installation team very good, punctual and tidy.

I’ve engaged Island Energy in San Remo for the install of a 13.2kw system with Tesla 13.2kw battery on 1 of the 2 phases.The solar system powers both phases but the battery can only be installed onto one of them.This was explained in great detail and we have worked out what we will have on the 1st phase that the battery will power up of a night.Island energy will also be changing out my 400L twin element electric hot water to a 305L heat exchange system.When you calculate the cost to run the old one it is a no brainer that the purchase and run costs of the new one is a far better option.I was upgrading my sub board from 24 pole to 32 pole and Mark at Island energy has agreed to have his guys fit the new sub board I’m supplying at no extra charge.The hot water isn’t your straight change over, the new one will be outside and there is extensive pipe work to be done but this is included in the price of the install.Although I don’t have the system installed yet, I’m not far off being ready for the guys to come past and do it. Pre Christmas install is on the cards, the guys are waiting on me.I have been reassured the install will be of the quality I have stated and expecting.I’m confident that Island energy in San Remo will do an install above my expectations. I will post pics at a later date when the install is complete.Cheers Thanks Mark M.A.M.
Everything good, just waiting for final inspection which is pending. Connection to the grid will follow after that.
From sales to installation Island Energy were faultless. They came and they went with minimum disruption (in fact no disruption). Highly recommend Island Energy.Des
Quote process was straight forward. Consultant came to the house whereas the other one quoted remotely.
Made the process easy and they informed me I have 3 phase and upgraded the SMA inverter. Very happy so far.
Island energy was thorough and efficient Have just had the electrician over to inspect so awaiting connection The customer service was great and job done quickly with no mess Altogether happy so far

We are still waiting for the system to be inspected and made operational.Everything else has gone very well and the company have been very professional and they appear to be very knowledgeable about their products.
One of your quoters was terrible and I let you know this as well and asked for a replacement quote. You responded with a survey, ignoring my request.

Extremely happy with Island Energy. They worked with me to make sure I got exactly what I wanted (8kw plus battery). They were more than understanding and helpful when I changed my quote around. Love the team and the service. I couldn't be happier
They even moved our antenna for free.
Impressed with Company - service & information & explanation
Great job thank you

I am unable to rate the value for money becauseofthe one quote, but I have been interested in Solar for many years. I had a figure in mind and the quote was well under what I expected. The "sales pitch" was really a conversation. The tricky question of " have you had many complaints"? The answer was honest and straightf forward. As for potential savings, it is too early to say.  It's only been five weeks and we are still not putting power into the grid. (power companys). But we have been using the power we generate to do our washing cleaning etc. The next account will show how much we can expect to save in the future.
Friendly helpful staff & installers, a very positive experience

Jims provides quotes on three different types of panels and inverters early and were very thorough.  We waited quite some time for the additional quotes which raised some concerns re follow up service.  We have not yet had the system installed so further feedback cannot be provided at this time.

The salesperson/owner was extremely helpful in advising me of how the productworks.Advising me of best position etc for the roof.I have had pre wiring done as house is not ready  yet for installation.This was a local company who came out and met me at the house.For the other companies they sent an email with the price.This company kept in regular contact with my enquiries.Thanks

Island Energy was very prompt in responding to the request for a quote. The explanations about installation and the process to register for the feed-in tariff etc., were clear. They organised delivery of the components over the Christmas/New Year break and installation was in early January. There have been no problems with the equipment and it all works as advertised.
